candidate_sentence_map.S1: AS Merko Ehitus reported a mixed first half of 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Revenue declined 10.7% year on year to EUR 149.9 million, although second-quarter revenue increased 12.1% to EUR 92.7 million from EUR 82.6 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Profitability weakened substantially in the six-month comparison: operating profit fell 55.1% to EUR 8.4 million, pre-tax profit dropped 54.1% to EUR 10.8 million, and net profit attributable to shareholders decreased 40.8% to EUR 12.8 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Net profit margin fell to 8.6% from 12.9%, while earnings per share declined to EUR 0.73 from EUR 1.22.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Second-quarter net profit was EUR 8.5 million, compared with EUR 11.2 million in the prior-year quarter.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The decline was primarily reflected in the construction service and real estate development segments.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Construction service revenue decreased 1.5% to EUR 118.3 million, while operating profit fell 65.5% to EUR 3.0 million and its margin declined to 2.6% from 7.3%.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: The report attributes the lower margin to the expiration of successful contracts from earlier periods and a return to more typical margins in a highly competitive market, with first-half results also affected by first-quarter seasonality.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Real estate development revenue fell 33.9% to EUR 31.6 million, and operating profit declined 40.8% to EUR 7.0 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Apartment sales decreased to 120 from 222, while revenue from apartment sales fell to EUR 27.6 million from EUR 44.9 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: In the second quarter, however, apartment-sale revenue was broadly stable at EUR 20.6 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: The strongest development was in the secured order book, which reached a record EUR 835.7 million at 30 June 2026, up approximately 88% from EUR 443.8 million a year earlier.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Group companies signed contracts worth EUR 486.4 million in the first half, more than double the EUR 223.1 million signed in the comparable period.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Large public-sector, Rail Baltica, defence-related and energy-infrastructure projects supported the order book, including the Rūdninkai defence campus, whose construction commenced at full scale after the reporting date.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Higher construction input prices, energy costs, inflationary pressure and continued competition affected margins.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Residential markets remained price-sensitive, with demand concentrated in more affordable apartments, although activity improved in Riga.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Operating cash flow was negative at EUR 31.6 million, mainly due to increased inventories and construction-contract balances, while development investment rose to EUR 42.6 million from EUR 22.5 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Cash and cash equivalents were EUR 39.6 million, up from EUR 25.9 million, but net debt increased to EUR 29.6 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Equity remained strong at EUR 251.1 million, representing 57.4% of assets.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: The candidate summary adequately represents the core material meaning of K1-K8, covering headline financial performance, order book growth, segment performance, major projects, real estate activity, market outlook, profitability metrics, and liquidity position. However, K9 (Dividend payment) and K10 (Post-reporting-period event) are missing entirely, resulting in a 'Generally yes' score (3). The absence of these two medium-importance items does not fundamentally alter the overall financial picture but represents notable omissions.
